Lena — thanks for sending these over, we got both PDFs and the MP4 link in Drive. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Logo placement: sponsor logos will appear on the ON24 stage header (700x100 PNG) and on the replay thumbnail. Marissa will confirm exact pixel placement and provide proof before publish.

- Streaming access: Technical ops needs RTMP key + passcode config from ON24 for our encoder. I’ll open a ticket with ON24 to request the stream endpoint and confirm passcode policy.

Hi ON24 Support —

We are producing an ON24 webinar for client AcmeCorp on 2027-04-20 (internal event ID: 20270420-ACME). Need help confirming a few items before our dress rehearsal on 2027-04-18: 

1) Please provide the staging RTMP endpoint, stream key, and recommended encoder settings (bitrate, keyframe interval) for 1080p pre-roll + live speaker feed.
2) Can you enable a sponsor overlay watermark for the on-demand replay and set retention to 90 days for that overlay only? If overlay retention is not separable from replay retention, what are our options?
3) Passcode policy: will a passcode be required on the RTMP ingest or only on the viewer side? We need to support token-auth ingestion from our encoder (Wirecast/OBS) and may also use Redwood’s private VPC routing.
4) Any known caveats for delivering MP4 pre-rolls larger than 250MB (Acme pre-roll is ~140MB, H.264).

Attachments: ben_stream_instructions.txt (encoder presets and our staging IPs).

Please reply with the endpoints and any config notes so we can run a successful dry run.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Hi Ben / team —

Thanks for the details. Quick responses below: 

1) Staging RTMP endpoint & stream key: rtmp://staging.on24.com/live — stream key: STG-ACME-33a2 (we've provisioned and will rotate after production). Recommended encoder settings: 5 Mbps target bitrate for 1080p, 2s keyframe, AAC-LC audio at 128 kbps.

2) Sponsor overlay watermark: we can enable an overlay layer that is shown on-demand for 90 days. This overlay can be applied at the event-level for the Acme sponsor only. If you prefer the overlay to be burned into the master, we can provide transcoding options (additional cost).

3) Passcode policy: viewer passcodes and registration gates are separate from RTMP ingest. RTMP ingest supports token-based auth from your IPs; no viewer passcode is required on ingest. If you need IP whitelisting, provide the IP ranges and we'll add them to the staging allowlist.

4) MP4 pre-roll size: 140MB is fine. Please upload to your account assets or share the Drive link and we will copy it into the ON24 asset library for the event. Provide MD5 if you can.

We also scheduled the stage for your rehearsal slot 2027-04-18 10:00 PT and added Lena as a backstage attendee. Let us know if you want us to pre-configure the overlay and thumbnail.

Regards,
ON24 Support Team
